Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

My Sri Lankan friend and my Ethiopian friend are both travelling from their home countries to visit me next week! I'm so excited because I'm sure my Sri Lankan friend has never seen a country as nice as this one and might even be overwhelmed by all the wealth, given how poor their family is back home. For my Ethiopian friend though, this is just one stop on what's actually a two month vacation. Who lives in poverty?
A. Unknown
B. The Sri Lankan friend
C. The Ethiopian friend
